about: Mode A / Mode B per leg (system brief 10) and how the mode is chosen at start. The probe is one GET on the connected-accounts list; the exact path is confirmed by T15 and recorded in docs/airwallex-contract.md. The receipt label is what the UI, the demo and the video show; a Mode B receipt never reads as a lender disbursement through the provider.

probe.call: GET connected accounts list (path confirmed in T15)

cases.note: an unclear probe never selects A; the health endpoint shows connected=false
forcing A on an account without it fails at start, with the provider's answer

cases.probe: the fake answers per its setting connected=true|false

mode_B.label: advance inflow (sandbox simulation)
mode_B.needs: a Global Account in the advance currency (GET /api/v1/global_accounts, or AIRWALLEX_GLOBAL_ACCOUNT_ID)

mode_A.header: x-on-behalf-of not used: the platform charges the connected account
mode_A.label: repayment (charge)

lf2_advance.note: the provider leg moves the principal only; the fee is a ledger journal (advance-journals.json in the ledger module), never a provider movement
